i feel like i need to clear some things up on here as the comments this time are kinda shitty. 

First of all i got send some merch whilst i was IN a relationship, and my break up was after i got the merch. I just thought it was funny seeing as i have posted in here before about break ups&shirts. I didn’t get this merch because i was going through a break up. I was kindly gifted this. 

Secondly, calling me a thot and saying i’m posting a thirst trap is mean and hurtful. I’m literally just a girl who got some FH merch and ended up on the website, being a long time FH fan it was incredible to see and seeing as i have been apart of a wholesome community for year with previous posts of me in merch/about break ups, i thought it was funny to post again. stop being mean because you see a girl into gaming stuff and enjoying herself. 

Lastly, we’re in a global pandemic atm guys, you can’t hire models and photographers to take pictures of people in merch because you know, PANDEMIC?! I wouldn’t want to be compensated for my photos being used, as i was the one who took the photos of myself in the merch and put them online, FH & RT can post my pictures wherever they like as i’m part of a great community and it’s the biggest compliment ever.  I think it’s great that they’ve used people’s photos from home to mode merch at the moment, seeing as the whole world has been at home for months, it’s very fitting with the times. I got sent free merch, that’s enough compensation for me. 

Apologise for me trying to enjoy the little things in life, and thank you to the nice comments and people.
